name: OpenCTI
description: Threat intelligence platform for structuring, storing, and visualizing knowledge on threats and campaigns.

envVars.description: Initial API token (must be a valid UUID)
MinIO root password for internal object storage

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      ELASTICSEARCH__URL: "http://{{serviceName}}-elasticsearch:9200"
      REDIS__HOSTNAME: "{{serviceName}}-redis"
      RABBITMQ__HOSTNAME: "{{serviceName}}-rabbitmq"
      MINIO__ENDPOINT: "{{serviceName}}-minio"
      MINIO__ACCESS_KEY: opencti
      APP__ADMIN__EMAIL: {{env.APP__ADMIN__EMAIL}}
      APP__ADMIN__PASSWORD: {{env.APP__ADMIN__PASSWORD}}
      APP__ADMIN__TOKEN: {{env.APP__ADMIN__TOKEN}}
      APP__BASE_URL: {{env.APP__BASE_URL}}
      MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: {{env.MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/logs:/opt/opencti/logs
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
  {{serviceName}}-elasticsearch:
    image: docker.elastic.co/elasticsearch/elasticsearch:8.15.1
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-elasticsearch
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      discovery.type: single-node
      xpack.security.enabled: false
      ES_JAVA_OPTS: "-Xms2g -Xmx2g"
  {{serviceName}}-rabbitmq:
    image: rabbitmq:3-management
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-rabbitmq
    restart: unless-stopped
  {{serviceName}}-minio:
    image: minio/minio:latest
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-minio
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: "server /data"
    environment:
      MINIO_ROOT_USER: opencti
